leads.name: Woodstock Monkey Puzzle Walk
leads.location: Woodstock Gardens, Inistioge; register record 64 at 52.47418,-7.05854 (Avenue, 150-200 years)
leads.reason: Verify pass 2026-11-03: avenue, so not a single collectible point (rule). Owner woodstock.ie: 'one of the longest Monkey Puzzle Avenues in Europe', set out north/south south of the former house. Decision for Hidde whether the avenue gets a point at one end.
